nodes.label: HMAC-SHA256 Webhook Signature Validation
nodes.rationale: Validates that incoming webhook POSTs genuinely originate from Meta using a timing-safe HMAC comparison, preventing spoofed lead events before any processing occurs.

nodes.label: Vercel Dynamic Outbound IP vs Fixed-Host MySQL Grants
nodes.rationale: Vercel serverless functions run on AWS with dynamic outbound IPs, so a MySQL user/firewall restricted to localhost or a fixed host rejects the connection with an EC2-hostname access-denied error; the fix is a wildcard-host DB user plus firewall access to port 3306.
